app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user
RCA_gt: The `user-service` deployment is explicitly scaled to `0` replicas and AIOpsLab waits 30 seconds for termination. With no user-service pods remaining, dependent Social Network operations cannot reach that service.
_source_comment: Ground truth source: AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/scale_pod/scale_pod_social_net.py (faulty_service, injector call, and 30s wait); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/generators/fault/inject_virtual.py (kubectl scale to zero); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/registry.py (problem ID).
